verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document whether meeting data is used to train AI models, offers no org-level training opt-out, and never mentions SOC 2 or HIPAA. Retention policies (including zero-day retention), org-wide recording policies, and the generic 'enterprise-grade security' claim are adjacent controls, not this capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
